1. Cast Disperse targeting Shimmerscale Drake.
2. Cast Invocation of Saint Traft targeting Kari Zev, Skyship Raider.
3. Move to combat and declare Kari Zev and Pathmaker Initiate as attackers (exert is irrelevant here).
4. Kari Zev’s trigger creates Ragavan; Invocation’s trigger creates the 4/4 Angel; both enter tapped and attacking.
5. With Pathmaker Initiate still able to activate, tap it targeting Ragavan, giving Ragavan “can’t be blocked this turn.”
6. Declare blockers. The only remaining blockers are the two Labyrinth Guardians. Because they lack flying they cannot block the Angel; because Ragavan is unblockable they cannot block it either. The only legal declarations are therefore both Guardians on Kari Zev or both (or one) on Pathmaker Initiate. In every legal case the unblocked creatures total exactly 8 power (Angel 4 + Ragavan 2 + the remaining 2-power ground creature).
7. After blockers are declared, cast Consuming Fervor targeting one of the unblocked creatures (+3/+3). The unblocked team now totals 11 power.
8. Combat damage is dealt; the opponent takes 11 and loses.

The solution uses Sigarda’s Aid (flash on Auras/Equipment), Pathmaker Initiate’s ability (no “as a sorcery” restriction, therefore instant-speed), menace, flying restrictions on blockers, and a post-blockers pump.

<solution>
1. Cast Disperse targeting Shimmerscale Drake.
2. Cast Invocation of Saint Traft targeting Kari Zev, Skyship Raider.
3. Move to combat and declare Kari Zev and Pathmaker Initiate as attackers (exert is irrelevant here).
4. Kari Zev’s trigger creates Ragavan; Invocation’s trigger creates the 4/4 Angel; both enter tapped and attacking.
5. With Pathmaker Initiate still able to activate, tap it targeting Ragavan, giving Ragavan “can’t be blocked this turn.”
6. Declare blockers. The only remaining blockers are the two Labyrinth Guardians. Because they lack flying they cannot block the Angel; because Ragavan is unblockable they cannot block it either. The only legal declarations are therefore both Guardians on Kari Zev or both (or one) on Pathmaker Initiate. In every legal case the unblocked creatures total exactly 8 power (Angel 4 + Ragavan 2 + the remaining 2-power ground creature).
7. After blockers are declared, cast Consuming Fervor targeting one of the unblocked creatures (+3/+3). The unblocked team now totals 11 power.
8. Combat damage is dealt; the opponent takes 11 and loses.
</solution>

(The mana for Disperse + Invocation + Fervor is obtained by first cycling Djeru’s Resolve, drawing the promised Plains and playing it as a sixth land.)
